name: portal-loop-v1
prompt: Create a production-ready transparent PNG animation sprite sheet for a top-down fantasy dungeon defense game, matching the attached reference object's gray chunky stonework, painterly pixel-game aesthetic and viewpoint. Exactly NINE frames arranged in a perfectly regular 3 columns x 3 rows grid on a square canvas; each equal square cell is a consecutive frame, row-major. A single object centered at identical position and scale in every cell, generous transparent padding, every object entirely contained in its own cell. Stone structure absolutely stationary and IDENTICAL across all frames, animate only light/flame/swirl. Subtle smooth nine-phase seamless looping motion with coherent progression, no jump at wraparound. No labels, no letters, no Korean text, no numbers, no grid lines, no borders, no scenery, no floor, no cast ground shadows, no background; true transparent alpha including cell gaps. Preserve the reference silhouette and readable game size. The object is the entrance: a standing arched dark gray stone portal with vivid purple magical vortex inside. Animate a luminous violet curling spiral rotating inside the arch and delicate pulsing purple wisps, while the entire arched stone frame stays perfectly fixed. Remove reference floor and label. Portal fills about 82% of each cell height and 60% width.
